## Description {#details}

<p>This is an extension point for target-specific <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcexpr">MCExpr</a> subclasses to implement.</p>


<p>NOTE: All subclasses are required to have trivial destructors because MCExprs are bump pointer allocated and not destructed.</p>
